reviews.title: An excellent product, well-built and worth every penny!
reviews.body: While perhaps more expensive than some powered USB hubs, this one is exceptionally well built and designed. I needed more USB 3.2 connections that were easily accessible, and my desktop has two unused ones, but on the back of the computer. This device allows me to use one of those and put 10 USB 3.2 ports directly in reach on my desk at all times. I wish I had purchased this a year ago! I love this device and it works perfectly. I especially like the fact that it gives me a LOT more USB 3.2 C's because me desktop (new last summer) only has ONE USB-C on the front. Now I have six of them! reviews.title: It works fine, but...
reviews.body: I was really excited for this USB hub, but it has way less utility for me than I realized. I typically work off of a docking station and switch between my personal and work MacBooks on it. The docking station is a pretty old one and it doesn't have any USB-C ports, so I can't plug this into it directly with the included cable. At first I figured, no problem, I'll just grab a C to A cable and plug it in with that. I was about to, and was assessing which of my old, janky USB hubs could have their connected accessories moved over to this much sleeker hub, when I realized that my worst USB hub has 7 ports, all in use, and they are all USB-A. So I could move over 4/7 accessories to this hub, but would either need to use A to C converters for the rest of them or keep using the old, unreliable hub anyway for three of the things (or plug the old hub into this one and have 3 accessories connected to this new hub while 4 remained plugged into the old one which is going through a second layer of hub-ness now). I should have thought this through before ordering, but I have exactly zero peripherals that connect to my computer with a USB-C plug. I know that is slowly changing over time, but it makes sense because so many older computers (and docking stations) don't have any USB-C ports. My personal MacBook Pro M3 does, and I could connect this hub directly to my MacBook with the included USB-C to C cable, but there would be no point to because I don't have any accessories that use a USB-C connection. I have a TON of peripherals, including the basics like a keyboard, mouse, and webcam, as well as some less common things like a Wacom tablet I don't use very often, but literally none of them come with a C to C cable, even if they have a C connection on the peripheral itself, as is the case with my current daily driver keyboard. I could swap out the cable for a C to C one so that I could use this dock, but that feels like more trouble than it's worth. I did set it up to test the charging capabilities, and it does give 45W according to the System Report on my MacBook Pro M3. Usually it takes about 65W to keep it charged while actively in use, but 45W is fine for overnight charging or light use, in my experience. All that being said, I just don't really have much use for this, although it does appear to be as advertised. Not knocking any stars because it does work as expected, it's just not useful to me, personally.

reviews.title: good quality
reviews.body: This UGREEN 5-in-1 USB-C hub is a compact and practical adapter that adds useful extra ports to a laptop. The 4K HDMI output works well for connecting to external monitors, and the USB ports handle devices like flash drives and keyboards without issues. The 100W power delivery passthrough is also convenient for charging while using other accessories. Build quality feels solid, and it’s truly plug-and-play with no setup needed. The only minor downside is that it can get a bit warm during extended use, and performance may vary if multiple devices are connected at once. Overall, a reliable and portable hub that works well for everyday use at home, work, or while traveling.

Second, this adds all the necessary ports she needs. She is able to attach multiple USB-A ports (mice and keyboard attachments). She can attach the HDMI between the adapter and her screen for seamless compatibility. Everything she needs to do in order to work her desktop station between reading flash drives, attaching monitors, keyboards, and mice works perfectly. This adapter is a cost-effective solution that is high quality and solves what we need. others might needs SD and other ports; however, we do not. I am very happy with how well this works, how sturdy the build is, and how beneficial this is to creating an ultimate setup with peripherals connected the Neo. I highly recommend this!

reviews.title: Hub USB-C fiable et compact, parfait pour un usage quotidien
reviews.body: Ce hub USB-C fait exactement ce qu'on attend de lui : il est conforme à la description, fonctionne sans accroc et permet de connecter facilement plusieurs périphériques à un ordinateur portable ou une tablette. Les ports répondent bien, aucun bug ou déconnexion à signaler, même lors de transferts de fichiers un peu lourds. Il est compact, léger et se glisse facilement dans une sacoche, ce qui le rend idéal pour un usage nomade. Les finitions sont propres, le branchement est immédiat et sans configuration. J'apprécie aussi la stabilité de la connexion, ce qui n'est pas toujours le cas avec des hubs bon marché. Satisfait de cet achat, c’est un bon accessoire pour améliorer la connectique d’un appareil moderne limité en ports.
